using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Tests.Connectors.Ollama.Extensions
{
    public class OllamaServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddOllamaTextGeneration_UsesGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Setup mocks for IServiceProvider to simulate GetService calls
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var mockOllamaApiClient = new Mock<OllamaApiClient>(MockBehavior.Strict);

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            // Setup GetService calls to return null for first calls, then return the mock OllamaApiClient
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(OllamaApiClient))).Returns(mockOllamaApiClient.Object);

            // Add the service provider mock to the service collection
            services.AddSingleton(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Act
            var resultServices = services.AddOllamaTextGeneration(ollamaClient: null, serviceId: null);

            // Build the service provider from the collection
            var builtProvider = resultServices.BuildServiceProvider();

            // Resolve the ITextGenerationService to trigger the factory delegate
            var textGenerationService = builtProvider.GetService<ITextGenerationService>();

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(textGenerationService);
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(OllamaApiClient)), Times.AtLeastOnce);
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddOllamaTextGeneration_ThrowsIfNoOllamaClient()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Setup a service provider that returns null for all GetService calls
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(null);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(OllamaApiClient))).Returns(null);

            services.AddSingleton(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            {
                var resultServices = services.AddOllamaTextGeneration(ollamaClient: null, serviceId: null);
                var builtProvider = resultServices.BuildServiceProvider();
                var service = builtProvider.GetService<ITextGenerationService>();
            });

            Assert.Contains("No IOllamaApiClient implementations found", ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(textGenerationService);
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(OllamaApiClient)), Times.AtLeastOnce);

            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetKeyedService<OllamaApiClient>(It.IsAny<string?>())).Returns((OllamaApiClient?)null);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetKeyedService<IOllamaApiClient>(It.IsAny<string?>())).Returns((IOllamaApiClient?)null);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(OllamaApiClient))).Returns((OllamaApiClient?)null);
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOllamaApiClient>()).Throws(new InvalidOperationException());

            services.AddSingleton(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Act & Assert

                var resultServices = services.AddOllamaTextGeneration(ollamaClient: null, serviceId: null);
